content:
RSSB Senior Secondary (10+2) CET syllabus is designed for intermediate-level common eligibility testing in Rajasthan.

Main areas

  • History, Geography, Culture of Rajasthan & India
  • Polity, Economy and Current Affairs
  • General Science
  • Mathematics / Mental Ability
  • General Hindi & General English
  • Basic Computer knowledge (if notified)

Download Advt. syllabus PDF from rssb.rajasthan.gov.in.
